Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this Oman Quadrangular series 2022 and it is United Arab Emirates who have clinched this series. They will be pretty proud and pleased about their performance in the series and would like to build on this in future. There is plenty of cricket action going around in the world. So do join us for for that. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland, says that they were atleast 20 short and it was their worst batting display of the series but the bowling and fielding effort was too notch. He adds that they want to build a competitive side and give more and more players to show their capabilities. He also mentions that they have another tournament coming up with some competitive sides in the mix and they will look to give their best.
Dipendra Singh Airee is the Player of the Match. He says that parctice has helped him and he is playing well. He mentions that he likes batting more.

Sandeep Lamichhane, the skipper of Nepal, says that the middle overs were crucial and the Irish bowlers bowled really well. He adds that they just couldn't get a move on and the whole side should learn from Airee on how to bat on this surface and hails his bowling as well. He ends by saying that they had a lot to learn from this match and are looking forward to the tournament ahead.
Stay tuned for the presentation.

Nepal would have felt super confident when they restricted a good batting opponent to a below par score of just 128. They had the batting prowess but unfortunately none of them could fire. Airee tried his best to hold up one end but no one could give him ample support. In the end, it was a desperate and scrappy attempt from Nepal but they fell well short. An excellent tournament from them nonetheless and they will gain a lot of experience from this series.

What a brilliant encounter we have witnessed here! Ireland were under the cosh and had their task cut out in front of them. A stellar bowling and fielding display has seen them notch up a clinical win but unfortunately it wasn't enough. UAE still have a better run rate and will go home with the series win. UAE were disappointed early on not being able to seal the deal against Oman and had to rely on this match. But overall they have been the better side and beating Ireland was the big moment, a moment that win them the series probably.

A length delivery on off. Jitendra Mukhiya heaves it towards deep square leg for a single. So a very good bowling performance by Ireland and they have defeneded a very low total here. Ireland win by 16 runs.
A fuller delivery on middle. Jitendra Mukhiya pushes it back to the bowler.
A fuller delivery on off. Bohara drills it to long on for a single.
A yorker outside off. Bohara digs it out.

OUT! CAUGHT! The skipper departs now and Ireland have pulled off a very good bowling performance here. Short delivery on off this time by Adair. Sandeep Lamichhane pull this but fails to get enough distance and finds Shane Getkate at deep square leg. An inspired bowling performance by Ireland and Nepal after playing so well are falling short here.
Commentary.Howout: c Shane Getkate b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: A very full delivery on off. Bohara drives it to deep cover for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Bohara pushes it to covers for a single.
A tossed up delivery on off. Sandeep Lamichhane goes for a big heave across the line but gets a top edge towards short third man for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two in two for Simi Singh! A fuller delivery on middle. It's a leg spinner again. Kamal Singh looks to launch it straight down the ground but fails to get enough distance. The fielder at long on Mark Adair takes an easy catch and things are falling apart for Nepal now. Sandeep Lamichhane is the next man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Abinash Bohara is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Malla departs now and more importantly it's a dot ball! A shorter length delivery on middle. Malla pulls it but fails to get the middle of his blade. The ball goes towards long on and the fielder there Barry McCarthy runs ahead to take a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Barry McCarthy b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up outside off and turning away. Singh only manages to hit it towards long off for a single.
Shorter and around leg. Malla pulls it to short fine leg for a single.
SIX! Ohh.what a shot under pressure! 24 needed now from 12 balls! A low full toss around leg. Singh just whips this off his legs over deep square leg for a biggie. Superb shot.
Another short ball on middle, this time a pacy one. Singh goes for the pull-shot again but misses. The ball hits him on the grill of his helmet.
A slower short ball this time on middle. Singh looks to pull but misses. The ball hits his shoulder and goes towards the off side.
A shorter delivery outside off. Malla cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Wide! This is fuller and wider outside off. Malla goes chasing for it but misses.
A fuller delivery on off. Singh hits it to long off for just a single.
Dot ball! A length delivery around leg. Singh swings across the line but misses.
Back of a length, around leg. Singh looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits him on the body and a leg bye is taken towards the leg side. 33 needed now from 18 balls.

FOUR! Crucial boundary this! A low full toss, outside off. Singh throws his bat at that one. The ball catches the bottom of his blade and races towards the third man fence for a boundary. That shot has broken the bottom of his blade.
Back of a length, on middle. Malla works it to square leg for a single.
On a length, on middle. Singh slams it to long on for just a single.
Kamal Singh is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Is this the game for Ireland? A length delivery on off. Airee looks to slap it over long on. He gets good timing on that but not enough to clear the long fielder. Adair there runs to his right and takes a fine catch near the ropes. A big wicket this and Barry McCarthy provides the breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Barry McCarthy

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Shorter and down the leg side. Airee looks to pulls it but misses.
A length delivery outside off. Malla cuts it to deep cover for a single.
A single now! 42 needed from 24 balls. A flatter delivery on middle. Malla pushes it towards point for a single.
Slightly shorter on length on off. Airee looks to pull but gets the bottom of his blade and  a single is taken towards backward point.
FOUR! Airee with another supeb shot! A fuller delivery on off. Airee reverse-sweeps it towards backward point for a boundary.
A fuller delivery on off. Airee drives it to covers.
Malla takes a single and brings Airee on strike. A slower delivery on middle. Malla pushes it to mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Airee drives it to long off for a single.
Full, on middle. Flicked away to deep square leg for a single.
On off, worked towards point for a single.
Fullish ball, angling into middle and leg. Malla whips it straight to square leg.
A length ball, on off. Airee drives it towards cover for a single.
Fuller, around off. Pushed towards cover.
SIX! Short and wide, Dipendra Singh Airee dances down the track and slashes it hard and gets it all the way over the cover fence. Nepal need more of these.
Quicker, on middle. Airee pushes it out towards wide mid on for a single.
On the pads, worked through mid-wicket for just a single.
Flatter, on middle. Malla has to go on the back foot to keep it out.
No run there! On off, cutaway to point.
Beaten! Pushed through quicker, around off. Malla leans in to drive but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Sliding into off. Malla strides out to defend.
Fullish ball, on off. This is driven towards cover. 61 still needed off 42 balls.
Airee under pressure here. Length again, pushed wider. Airee looks to drive away from the body but gets an inside edge back onto the pads. He needs someone to stay with him.
Angled into middle, Malla hops and taps it through covers for a single.
Length again, around off. Malla looks to block but the ball zips past the outside edge.
Kushal Malla is the next man in.

OUT! LBW! Curtis Campher gets his man trapped in front and another one bites the dust for Nepal. A length ball, around off. This one jags back in sharply off the surface. Sharad Vesawkar tries to work it leg side but gets caught on the crease and gets pinged on the pads. The bowler lets out a huge appeal and the umoire slowly but surely raises his finger.
Banged in short, over middle. Dipendra Singh Airee plays a controlled pull shot, along the ground and towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
On the pads, Airee flicks it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on off. This is driven towards cover.
Nicely cutaway! Flatter, around off. Airee hangs back and cuts it behind point for a couple.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter, on off. This is blocked out.
Sharad Vesawkar is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Ireland tightening the screws and Nepal absolutely crumbling under pressure. Tossed up, on off. Gyanendra Malla pre-meditates and goes for the reverse swep. He gets a decent connection and to the left of sweeper cover. The fielder runs to his left and takes a comfortable catch. Andy McBrine has his second wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Gareth Delany b Andy McBrine

Commentary.Commentary: A good length ball, around off. Airee taps it to cover-point. Just 2 off it and Nepal need boundaries here.
On middle and leg, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Around the top of off. Malla mistimes it towards mid off.
A length ball, on middle. Malla defends it out.
On the pads, flicked away to deep square leg for a single.
Fullish ball, angled into middle and leg. Airee blocks it out.
A flatter delivery on off. It is quicker. Malla plays it back to the bowler. 69 needed from 60 balls now.
A flatter delivery outside off. Airee pushes it to backward point for another single.
Slighty shorter on off. Malla goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Airee drives it to long off for a single.
A quicker delivery on off. Airee pushes it to covers now.
A flatter ball, on off. Malla works it to short third man and takes a quick single.
A length ball, around off. Malla steers it to third man for a single. 74 needed now from 66 balls.

Ohhh...almost an another wicket! Back of a length, outside off. Airee looks to punch it towards the off side but gets a thick inside edge past stumps. The ball goes to short fine leg and a single is taken.
Slightly shorter on off. Airee pulls but mistimes it to mid-wicket.
Campher hits the length hard again on middle. Malla works it to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, outside off. Airee steers it to third man for a single.
On a length, on middle. Airee works it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off this time. Malla blocks this off the front foot.
A flatter delivery on middle. Malla drives it to mid on now.
Tossed up on off. Malla looks to hit it towards the leg side but gets a leading edge towards covers.
A fuller delivery on off. Airee drives it to long off for a single.
Gyanendra Malla is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another batter goes in a bid to clear the fence! A tossed up delivery on off. Aasif Sheikh gets low and slog-sweeps it to deep square leg. He fails to get the desired distance and ends up finding George Dockrell at deep square leg. He takes an easy catch and Ireland are chiiping in with wickets here.
Commentary.Howout: c George Dockrell b Andy McBrine

Commentary.Commentary: A fuller delivery on off. Aasif Sheikh drives it to deep extra-cover for a couple. Good running this.
Andy McBrine is into the attack now.
A fuller delivery on off. Dipendra Singh Airee drives it to deep extra cover for a couple.
Back of a length, on middle. Dipendra Singh Airee works it to mid-wicket now.
Shorter length delivery on off. Aasif Sheikh mistimes his pull to mid off for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Aasif Sheikh blocks it out this time.
FOUR! Another brilliant shot! A length ball, on off. Aasif Sheikh skips down the track and hammers it over mid off for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Dipendra Singh Airee pushes it to covers for a single.
FOUR! Good shot this! Short and wide outside off. Aasif Sheikh cuts it left of point and gets a boundary. 40/2 after Powerplay.
Back of a length, outside off. Aasif Sheikh cuts it to point this time.
Dipendra Singh Airee is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Bam departs now and Ireland get their second wicket. A shorter length delivery on off. Bam pulls it aerially towards deep square leg but fails to get enough distance. The ball goes straight into the hands of George Dockrell there and he takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c George Dockrell b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Back of  a length on middle. Bam works it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Back of a length but down the leg side this time. Bam looks to clip it but misses.
A fuller delivery on off. Sheikh drives it to covers for a single.
Back of a length around leg. Bam looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits him high on the pads and there is a huge appeal. The umpire is not interested and a leg bye is taken towwards the leg side.
Mark Adair is back on.
Leg bye! Angling into middle and leg, Bam looks to work it leg side but misses. The ball hits the pad and rolls onto the off side. The batters get a leg bye.
Nicely bowled! A length ball, on off and just nipping away. Bam has a poke at it but gets beaten past the outside edge.
SIX! Clean strike! A length ball, on off. Lokesh Bam clears the front leg and whacks it flat and over the long on fence for a biggie. Less than 100 required now.
A length ball, close to the off pole. Bam leaves it alone.
On off. Lokesh Bam stays solid in defense.
Lokesh Bam walks in at number 3.

OUT! BOWLED! Here comes the first breakthrough! Barry McCarthy backs up his maiden over with a wicket here. A length ball, angled into leg. Kushal Bhurtel tries to get funky and shuffles across to flicks it over short fine leg. He misses the ball and the leg stump is knocked over. Ireland are well and alive now.
Fuller, on middle. Bhurtel turns it through wide mid on for a run.
On middle, Sheikh chips it down towards long on for a single.
A bit of width on offer, Sheikh backs away and slices it over point for a couple.
Quicker and fuller, on middle. Blocked out.
SIX! Nicely tossed up, around middle and leg. Aasif Sheikh clears the front leg and smokes it over the long on fence for a maximum.
On off, Bhurtel plays the paddle sweep and gets a tope edge past short fine leg for a single.
Excellent bowling! Around the top of off. Sheikh blocks it out. End of a maiden over.
Sliding into middle and leg, nudged away towards mid-wicket.
Length again, around the top of off. Blocked out.
A good length ball, over off. Shekih goes for the big swipe leg side but completely misses the ball.
On off, pushed out to mid off.
Full and on leg, this is blocked out.
Barry McCarthy is into the attack now. He replaces Mark Adair after just one over.
SIX! Nepal are going for broke here! Tossed up, on middle. Kushal Bhurtel plays the slog sweep and gets it high and handsome over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
On middle, pulled away to dep mid-wicket for a run.
Angling into middle and le, worked through deep mid-wicket for one.
On middle, Aarif Sheikh drives it down to long on for one. He's off the mark now.
Flatter, around off. This is pushed towards off.
Nicely tossed up, on off. Sheikh drives it straight to cover.
Simi Singh will share the new ball with Mark Adair.
On off. Blocked out.
Slashed away and slashed away well. Wide of off stump and Kushal Bhurtel goes hard at it. The ball flies over backward point. The fielder from third man puts in the dive and keeps it to two.
Nicely timed for no run. A length ball, around off. Bhurtel taps it towards cover.
Very full, around off. This is driven towards cover.
Fullish ball, on off. This is pushed back towards the bowler.
FOUR! What a way to start off the innings! A length ball, on middle. Kushal Bhurtel leans in and punches it right back past the bowler for a boundary to get Nepal underway.
